name: frontend-dependency-docs
body: README.md (and the pipeline section of AGENTS.md) documents the frontend dependency contract. The formula list, Install snippets, and Requirements section already name all eight frontends (`apg-go` through `apg-md`, including `apg-py`/`apg-md`). The real gaps are: the intro sentence and the Features bullet list only six languages (Go, Java, C++, Rust, TypeScript, C# — Python and Markdown are omitted from those two spots); the "Project layout" section omits `src/pylib`/`src/mdlib` (and the `apg-py.rb`/`apg-md.rb` formulae); the Requirements section names only `java` and `node` as scan-time dependencies, leaving `go` and `cargo`/`rustc` undocumented; and "Building from source" still describes a stale build (`cmake` plus a "bundled LadybugDB", whereas the real build links a prebuilt static `liblbug` and `openssl@3`). Acceptance: a reader can determine, per frontend, the build-time deps, the scan-time deps, and the engine pin from README.md; the intro/Features language lists and the project layout cover all eight frontends and their sources.
